title: Why is crypto down today? Sunday, November 8, 2026
h1: Why is crypto down today? Sunday, November 8, 2026
answer: Bitcoin down 0.94% over 24 hours and down 2.25% over seven days as the desk's Whale Watch board showed $2.292 billion in bitcoin moving off exchanges during the week ending Nov 08, a pattern of accumulation that contradicts spot Bitcoin ETF outflows of $411.9M on the day and $1,281.7M over the week.
Technical indicators show deep oversold conditions across major assets: Bitcoin's RSI at 35.8, Ether at 34.0, Cardano at 25.4.
The Fear and Greed Index closed at 28.
No near-term regulatory or market checkpoints are stated in the desk's coverage, but whale positioning and funding dynamics warrant close watching in the days ahead.

reported.line: Web3Auth moved $5.6 million from exposed Keplr wallets to prevent theft, but some funds were already stolen from affected users.
Democrats swept US midterm elections by a wider-than-expected margin, potentially shifting crypto policy toward tighter regulation and enforcement.
